# Patrice Lumumba

Ana ɗaukarsa a Jamhuriyar Dimokaraɗiyyar [Kongo](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kongo?action=edit&redlink=1 "Kongo (babu wannan shafin)") a matsayin "jarumin ƙasa" na farko na ƙasar bayan samun 'yancin kai.

## Tasowarsa da Karatu da Sana'a

[[gyara sashe](/w/index.php?title=Patrice_Lumumba&veaction=edit&section=1 "Gyara sashe: Tasowarsa da Karatu da Sana'a") | [gyara masomin](/w/index.php?title=Patrice_Lumumba&action=edit&section=1 "Edit section's source code: Tasowarsa da Karatu da Sana'a")]

An haifi [Patrice Émery](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Patrice_Émery?action=edit&redlink=1 "Patrice Émery (babu wannan shafin)") Lumumba a [Onalua](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Onalua?action=edit&redlink=1 "Onalua (babu wannan shafin)") (yankin Katako-gombe a cikin Sankuru, Kongo Belgian, a cikin Jamhuriyar Dimokuradiyyar [Kongo](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kongo?action=edit&redlink=1 "Kongo (babu wannan shafin)") a yanzu). Ya kuma halarci makarantar mishan na Katolika sannan ƙwararren ɗalibi ne a makarantar Furofesa. Har zuwa shekara ta 1954 (shekarar kafuwar cibiyar sadarwar ilimi ta duniya da jami'a ta farko), [Beljiyam](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Beljiyam?action=edit&redlink=1 "Beljiyam (babu wannan shafin)") ta mulkin mallaka kawai ta haɓaka tsarin ilimi, gaba ɗaya an danƙa wa ayyukan addini. Makarantar ta ba da ilimi na asali ne kawai kuma an fi son horar da ma'aikata fiye da magatakarda, amma [Lumumba](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lumumba?action=edit&redlink=1 "Lumumba (babu wannan shafin)"), wanda ya koyar da kansa, ya nutsar da kansa a cikin littattafan tarihi.

Ya yi aiki a matsayin ma'aikacin ofis a wani kamfanin hakar ma'adinai a ƙasar Kivu ta Kudu har zuwa shekarar 1945, sannan a matsayin ɗan jarida a [Léopoldville](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Léopoldville?action=edit&redlink=1 "Léopoldville (babu wannan shafin)") (yau Kinshasa) da [Stanleyville](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Stanleyville?action=edit&redlink=1 "Stanleyville (babu wannan shafin)") (Kisangani) ma'aikaci na 2 a ma'aikatar gidan waya, a lokacin ya rubuta a jaridu daban-daban.

A cikin watan [Satumbar](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Satumbar?action=edit&redlink=1 "Satumbar (babu wannan shafin)") shekarar 1954, ya karɓi katin "rejista", wanda gwamnatin [Belgium](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Belgium?action=edit&redlink=1 "Belgium (babu wannan shafin)") ta tanadar don wasu abubuwa masu mahimmanci na ƙasar (rajista 200 daga cikin miliyan 13 na mazaunan lokacin).

Ya gano, yayin da yake aiki da kamfanin haƙar ma'adinai, cewa albarkatun ƙasa na ƙasarsa na taka rawar gani a tattalin arziƙin [duniya](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Duniya "Duniya"), to amma kuma kamfanonin ƙasashen duniya ba sa yin wani abu da ya sa shugabannin ƙasar Kongo cikin tafiyar da waɗannan arziƙin. Sannan ya yi yaƙin neman dunkulewar [Kongo](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kongo?action=edit&redlink=1 "Kongo (babu wannan shafin)"), inda ya banbanta kansa da sauran 'yan awaren da jam'iyyunsu suka fi ƙabilanci, sun fi dacewa da tsarin tarayya 3. Masanin tarihin [Kongo](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kongo?action=edit&redlink=1 "Kongo (babu wannan shafin)") Isidore Ndaywel è Nziem ya ƙayyade: "[Lumumba](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lumumba?action=edit&redlink=1 "Lumumba (babu wannan shafin)"), saboda kasancewarsa Tetela, ya sa 'yan takararsa na "halitta" suka tarwatsa ko'ina cikin ƙasar, wanda ya tilasta masa ya buga katin kishin ƙasa"[[1]](#cite_note-1)[[2]](#cite_note-2)

Ba ya roƙon samun 'yancin kai nan da nan, musamman tun lokacin da ya fahimci cewa iyakokin [Belgian](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Belgian?action=edit&redlink=1 "Belgian (babu wannan shafin)") [Kongo](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kongo?action=edit&redlink=1 "Kongo (babu wannan shafin)") da maƙwabtan Faransanci da Ingilishi da [Portuguese](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Portuguese?action=edit&redlink=1 "Portuguese (babu wannan shafin)") sun zama masu mulkin mallaka, waɗanda masu mulkin mallaka suka kafa, wanda wata rana zai haifar da tambaya don rarraba dukiyar a tsakanin ƙasashen [Afirka](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Afirka "Afirka") masu cin gashin kansu nan gaba. A cikin shekarar 1955, ya ƙirƙiro wata ƙungiya "[APIC](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/APIC?action=edit&redlink=1 "APIC (babu wannan shafin)")" (Ƙungiyar ma'aikata ƴan asalin mulkin mallaka) kuma za su sami damar yin magana da Sarki Baudouin a kan tafiya zuwa Kongo, game da yanayin zamantakewa na [Kongo](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kongo?action=edit&redlink=1 "Kongo (babu wannan shafin)").[[3]](#cite_note-3)

### Shugaban NMC

[[gyara sashe](/w/index.php?title=Patrice_Lumumba&veaction=edit&section=2 "Gyara sashe: Shugaban NMC") | [gyara masomin](/w/index.php?title=Patrice_Lumumba&action=edit&section=2 "Edit section's source code: Shugaban NMC")]

[Patrice Lumumba](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Patrice_Lumumba) ya sami amincewar siyasa don samun 'yancin kansa daga tasirin [Belgium](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Belgium?action=edit&redlink=1 "Belgium (babu wannan shafin)") da kuma matsayinsa na [Afirka](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Afirka "Afirka"), wanda ya burge Kwame [Nkrumah](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nkrumah?action=edit&redlink=1 "Nkrumah (babu wannan shafin)") na kasar [Ghana](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ghana "Ghana") a taron jama'ar Afirka na shekara ta alif 1958[[4]](#cite_note-4). A shekarar 1959,jam'iyyarsa, MNC, ta rabu gida biyu: MNC-L ta [Lumumba](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lumumba?action=edit&redlink=1 "Lumumba (babu wannan shafin)") da kuma MNC-K mai tsattsauran ra'ayi. A cikin wannan shekarar, an kama [Lumumba](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lumumba?action=edit&redlink=1 "Lumumba (babu wannan shafin)") da laifin tada tarzomar adawa da mulkin mallaka a [Stanleyville](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Stanleyville?action=edit&redlink=1 "Stanleyville (babu wannan shafin)") wanda ya yi sanadin mutuwar mutane 30 kuma aka yanke masa hukuncin ɗaurin watanni shida a gidan yari. Duk da cewa an ɗaure shi, jam'iyyar MNC ta samu rinjaye a zaben ƙananan hukumomi da aka yi a watan [Disamba](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Disamba "Disamba") na shekarar 1959.Saboda matsin lamba daga sauran wakilai,an saki [Lumumba](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lumumba?action=edit&redlink=1 "Lumumba (babu wannan shafin)") don halartar taron 1960 na [Brussels](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Brussels "Brussels") [Round](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Round?action=edit&redlink=1 "Round (babu wannan shafin)") [Tebur](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tebur "Tebur") kan makomar [Kongo](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kongo?action=edit&redlink=1 "Kongo (babu wannan shafin)").

## Yancin kai da zaɓen Firayim Minista

[[gyara sashe](/w/index.php?title=Patrice_Lumumba&veaction=edit&section=3 "Gyara sashe: Yancin kai da zaɓen Firayim Minista") | [gyara masomin](/w/index.php?title=Patrice_Lumumba&action=edit&section=3 "Edit section's source code: Yancin kai da zaɓen Firayim Minista")]

Taron ya ƙare a ranar 27 ga watan [Janairu](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Janairu "Janairu") a shekarar 1960 tare da ayyana 'yancin kan [Kongo](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kongo?action=edit&redlink=1 "Kongo (babu wannan shafin)"), Ya sanya ranar 30 ga wata [Yuni](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Yuni "Yuni") a 1960 a matsayin ranar yancin kai tare da  [1960 zaɓen gama gari na ƙasar Belgium na Congo](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/1960_zaɓen_gama_gari_na_ƙasar_Belgium_na_Congo?action=edit&redlink=1 "1960 zaɓen gama gari na ƙasar Belgium na Congo (babu wannan shafin)") zaɓen ƙasa daga 11 zuwa 25 ga watan [Mayu](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mayu "Mayu") shekara ta alif 1960]].

Jam'iyyar [MNC](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/MNC?action=edit&redlink=1 "MNC (babu wannan shafin)") ta lashe zaɓe da dama a zaɓen.Makonni shida kafin ranar samun 'yancin kai, an naɗa [Walter Ganshof van der Meersch](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Walter_Ganshof_van_der_Meersch?action=edit&redlink=1 "Walter Ganshof van der Meersch (babu wannan shafin)") a matsayin Ministan Harkokin [Afirka](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Afirka "Afirka") na Belgium. Ya zauna a [Léopoldville](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Léopoldville?action=edit&redlink=1 "Léopoldville (babu wannan shafin)"), a zahiri ya zama ministan zama na [Belgium](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Belgium?action=edit&redlink=1 "Belgium (babu wannan shafin)") a [Kongo](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kongo?action=edit&redlink=1 "Kongo (babu wannan shafin)"), yana gudanar da shi tare da Gwamna Janar.

**Ghana** ƙasa ce mai zaman kanta ko kuma **Gana** ko **Jamhuriyar Ghana** (da Turanci: **Republic of Ghana**), ƙasa ce da ke a nahiyar [Afirka ta yankin kudu](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Afirka "Afirka").[[1]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ghana#cite_note-1)[[2]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ghana#cite_note-2)[[3]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ghana#cite_note-3)[Ghana](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ghana) tana da yawan fili kimanin kilomita murabba'i (238,540).[[4]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ghana#cite_note-4)[[5]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ghana#cite_note-5)[[6]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ghana#cite_note-6) Ghana tana da yawan jama'a kimanin (27,043,093) bisa ga jimillar kidaya ta shekara ta dubu biyu da goma Sha hudu (2014).[[7]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ghana#cite_note-7)[[8]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ghana#cite_note-8)[[9]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ghana#cite_note-9) Ghana tana da iyaka da [Côte d'Ivoire](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/C%C3%B4te_d'Ivoire "Côte d'Ivoire"), [Togo](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Togo "Togo") kuma da [Burkina Faso](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Burkina_Faso "Burkina Faso"). Babban birnin [Ghana](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ghana), [Accra](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Accra "Accra") ne.[[10]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ghana#cite_note-10)[[11]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ghana#cite_note-11)[[12]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ghana#cite_note-12)[Ghana](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ghana) ta kasance kasa mai bunkasa ta fannin ilimi da tattalin arziki acikin gaba daya fadin [Afirka](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Afirka "Afirka").[[13]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ghana#cite_note-13)[[14]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ghana#cite_note-14)[[15]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ghana#cite_note-15)

[Nana Akufo-Addo](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nana_Akufo-Addo "Nana Akufo-Addo") ne Shugaban ƙasar tare da mataimakin sa Mahamudu Bawumia, daga shekara ta (2017)[[16]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ghana#cite_note-16)[[17]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ghana#cite_note-17)[[18]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ghana#cite_note-18)

## Shekarar Samun ƴancin kai

[[gyara sashe](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Ghana&veaction=edit&section=1 "Gyara sashe: Shekarar Samun ƴancin kai") | [gyara masomin](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Ghana&action=edit&section=1 "Edit section's source code: Shekarar Samun ƴancin kai")]

Ghana ta samu yancin kanta a shekara ta alif ɗari tara da hamsin da bakwai(1957)A.C, daga ƙasar [Birtaniya](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Birtaniya "Birtaniya").[[19]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ghana#cite_note-19)[[20]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ghana#cite_note-20)[[21]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ghana#cite_note-21)

### Kimiyya da fasaha

[[gyara sashe](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Ghana&veaction=edit&section=2 "Gyara sashe: Kimiyya da fasaha") | [gyara masomin](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Ghana&action=edit&section=2 "Edit section's source code: Kimiyya da fasaha")]

Ghana ta ƙaddamar da hanyar sadarwa ta wayar salula a shekarar ta alif ɗari tara da hamsin da bakwai 1992. Daga baya aka haɗa ta da Intanet kuma ta gabatar da sabis na watsa shirye-shiryen ADSL.[[22]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ghana#cite_note-22)[[23]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ghana#cite_note-23)[[24]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ghana#cite_note-24)

Ghana ta kasance matsayi na 99 a cikin Ƙididdigar Innovation ta Duniya a cikin 2024.[[25]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ghana#cite_note-25)[[26]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ghana#cite_note-26)[[27]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ghana#cite_note-27)

Cibiyar Kimiyya da Fasaha ta Ghana (GSSTC) da Hukumar Kula da Sararin Samaniya ta Ghana (GhsA) suna kula da shirye-shiryen binciken sararin samaniya da sararin samaniya.[[28]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ghana#cite_note-28)[[29]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ghana#cite_note-29)[[30]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ghana#cite_note-30) GSSTC da GhsA sun yi aiki don a harba tauraron dan adam mai lura da tsaron ƙasa zuwa sararin samaniya a cikin 2015.[[31]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ghana#cite_note-31)[[32]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ghana#cite_note-32)[[33]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ghana#cite_note-33) Kudin binciken sararin samaniyar Ghana na shekara-shekara ya kasance kashi 1% na GDP, don tallafawa bincike kan kimiyya da fasaha.[[34]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ghana#cite_note-34)[[35]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ghana#cite_note-35)[[36]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ghana#cite_note-36) A cikin 2012, an zaɓi Ghana ta zama shugaban Hukumar Kimiyya da Fasaha don Ci Gaban Dorewa a Kudancin (Comsats); Ghana na da hadin gwiwa wajen binciken sararin samaniya tare da Hukumar Kula da Sararin Samaniya ta Afirka ta Kudu.[[37]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ghana#cite_note-37)[[38]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ghana#cite_note-38)[[39]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ghana#cite_note-39)

### Yawon shakatawa

[[gyara sashe](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Ghana&veaction=edit&section=3 "Gyara sashe: Yawon shakatawa") | [gyara masomin](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Ghana&action=edit&section=3 "Edit section's source code: Yawon shakatawa")]

A cikin 2011, masu yawon bude ido da suka ziyarci Ghana sun kai 1,087,000,[[40]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ghana#cite_note-40)[[41]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ghana#cite_note-41)[[42]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ghana#cite_note-42) tare da masu shigowa ciki har da Amurkawa ta Kudu, Asiyawa, Turawa, da Arewacin Amurka.[[43]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ghana#cite_note-43)[[44]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ghana#cite_note-44)[[45]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ghana#cite_note-45) Daga cikin abubuwan jan hankali da wuraren shakatawa akwai magudanan ruwa kamar magudanan ruwa na Kintampo da mafi girma a yammacin Afirka, magudanan ruwa na Wli,[[46]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ghana#cite_note-46)[[47]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ghana#cite_note-47)[[48]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ghana#cite_note-48) rairayin bakin teku masu cike da dabino, kogo, tsaunuka, koguna, da tafki da tafkuna irin su Lake Bosumtwi da tafki mafi girma da ɗan adam ya yi a duniya ta wurin sararin samaniya, tafkin Volta,[[49]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ghana#cite_note-49) wuraren adana dabino da yawa,[[50]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ghana#cite_note-50)[[51]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ghana#cite_note-51)[[52]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ghana#cite_note-52) wurare masu yawa na duniya. wuraren shakatawa.[164] Sanannen katanga sune Castle na Cape Coast da Castle na Elmina.[[53]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ghana#cite_note-53)[[54]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ghana#cite_note-54)[[55]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ghana#cite_note-55)[[56]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ghana#cite_note-56) Gine-gine suna nuna inda aka zubar da jini a cikin cinikin bayi da kuma adanawa da inganta al'adun Afirka da aka sace da kuma lalata su ta hanyar cinikin bayi.[[57]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ghana#cite_note-57)[[58]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ghana#cite_note-58)[[59]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ghana#cite_note-59) Yarjejeniyar Tarihi ta Duniya ta UNESCO ta sanya wa manyan gine-ginen Ghana da garu a matsayin abubuwan tarihi na duniya,[[60]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ghana#cite_note-60)[[61]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ghana#cite_note-61)[[62]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ghana#cite_note-62) bisa ma'auni: "Tsarin gine-gine da garu na Ghana sun tsara tarihin Ghana ba kawai ba amma na duniya fiye da shekaru hudu a matsayin abin da aka fi mayar da hankali na farko da cinikin zinari sannan kuma cinikin bayi. Suna da muhimmiyar alama kuma mai motsa rai na gamuwar Turai da Afirka da kuma farkon haduwar Afirka 6."[[63]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ghana#cite_note-63)[[64]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ghana#cite_note-64)[[65]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ghana#cite_note-65)

Kididdigar dandalin tattalin arzikin duniya a shekarar 2010 ta nuna cewa, daga cikin wuraren da aka fi son yawon bude ido a duniya, Ghana ta kasance ta 108 a cikin kasashe 139.[[66]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ghana#cite_note-66)[[67]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ghana#cite_note-67)[[68]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ghana#cite_note-68) Kasar ta koma matsayi biyu daga matsayi na 2009. A shekarar 2011, Mujallar Forbes ta wallafa cewa Ghana ce ta 11 a jerin kasashen da suka fi sada zumunci a duniya. Tabbacin ya dogara ne akan wani bincike da aka yi a shekarar 2010 na ɓangaren matafiya. ## Operation Cold Chop da kuma bayansa

[[gyara sashe](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Ghana&veaction=edit&section=4 "Gyara sashe: Operation Cold Chop da kuma bayansa") | [gyara masomin](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Ghana&action=edit&section=4 "Edit section's source code: Operation Cold Chop da kuma bayansa")]

Daga bisani kuma an hambarar da gwamnatin Nkrumah a wani juyin mulki da sojojin Ghana suka yi wa lakabi da "Operation Cold Chop".[[89]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ghana#cite_note-89)[[90]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ghana#cite_note-90)[[91]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ghana#cite_note-91) Wannan ya faru ne a lokacin da Nkrumah ke kasar waje tare da Zhou Enlai a Jamhuriyar Jama'ar kasar Sin,[[92]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ghana#cite_note-92)[[93]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ghana#cite_note-93)[[94]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ghana#cite_note-94) a wani aiki da ya kai birnin Hanoi na kasar Vietnam, don taimakawa kawo karshen yakin Vietnam. An yi juyin mulkin ne a ranar 24 ga Fabrairun 1966,[[95]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ghana#cite_note-95)[[96]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ghana#cite_note-96)[[97]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ghana#cite_note-97) karkashin jagorancin Kanar Emmanuel Kwasi Kotoka da Birgediya Akwasi Afrifa. An kafa Majalisar 'Yanci ta Kasa, karkashin jagorancin Laftanar Janar Joseph A. Ankrah.[[98]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ghana#cite_note-98)[[99]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ghana#cite_note-99)[[100]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ghana#cite_note-100)

Jerin gwamnatocin soji da na farar hula, wadanda sau da yawa matsalolin tattalin arziki ke shafar su,[[101]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ghana#cite_note-101)[[102]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ghana#cite_note-102)[[103]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ghana#cite_note-103) sun yi mulkin Ghana daga 1966, wanda ya ƙare tare da hawan jirgin Laftanar Jerry John Rawlings na Majalisar Tsaro ta Kasa a 1981.[[104]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ghana#cite_note-104)[[105]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ghana#cite_note-105)[[106]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ghana#cite_note-106) Wadannan sauye-sauye sun haifar da dakatar da kundin tsarin mulki a shekarar 1981 da kuma haramta jam'iyyun siyasa.[[107]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ghana#cite_note-107)[[108]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ghana#cite_note-108)[[109]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ghana#cite_note-109) Ba da daɗewa ba tattalin arziƙin ya ragu, don haka Rawlings ya yi shawarwari kan tsarin daidaitawa, canza tsoffin manufofin tattalin arziki, da haɓakar da aka samu a tsakiyar shekarun 1980.[[110]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ghana#cite_note-110)[[111]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ghana#cite_note-111)[[112]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ghana#cite_note-112) An fitar da sabon kundin tsarin mulki mai mayar da siyasar tsarin jam’iyyu da yawa a zaben shugaban kasa na 1992, inda aka zabi Rawlings, da kuma a babban zaben 1996.[[113]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ghana#cite_note-113)[[114]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ghana#cite_note-114)[[115]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ghana#cite_note-115)

A yakin kabilanci da aka yi a Arewacin Ghana a shekarar 1994, tsakanin Konkomba da wasu kabilu da suka hada da Nanumba, Dagomba da Gonja, an kashe mutane 1,000 zuwa 2,000 tare da raba mutane 150,000.[[116]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ghana#cite_note-116)[[117]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ghana#cite_note-117)[[118]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ghana#cite_note-118)

Bayan zaben gama gari na shekara ta 2000, John Kufuor na New Patriotic Party ya zama shugaban kasar Ghana a ranar 7 ga Janairun 2001 kuma aka sake zabe shi a shekara ta 2004,[[119]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ghana#cite_note-119)[[120]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ghana#cite_note-120)[[121]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ghana#cite_note-121) ta haka ne kuma ya yi wa'adi biyu (kayyade wa'adin) a matsayin shugaban kasar Ghana da kuma alama a karo na farko a karkashin jamhuriya ta hudu cewa an mika mulki daga wani zababben shugaban kasa da shugaban gwamnati zuwa wancan.[[122]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ghana#cite_note-122)[[123]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ghana#cite_note-123)[[124]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ghana#cite_note-124)

# Abubakar Adam Ibrahim

An haife shi a shekara ta ( 1979) a garin [Jos](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jos "Jos") ta Jihar [Plateau](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Plateau?action=edit&redlink=1 "Plateau (babu wannan shafin)") [Najeriya](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Najeriya "Najeriya"), ɗaya ne daga cikin marubuta a [Najeriya](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nijeriya "Nijeriya"). Ya kuma rubuta ƙagaggen labarin (*[Season](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Season?action=edit&redlink=1 "Season (babu wannan shafin)") of [Crimson](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Crimson?action=edit&redlink=1 "Crimson (babu wannan shafin)") [Blossoms](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Blossoms?action=edit&redlink=1 "Blossoms (babu wannan shafin)"))* (*kakar tsirowar jajayen furannai*). Ya lashe kyautar [adabi](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Adabi "Adabi") na [NLNG](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/NLNG?action=edit&redlink=1 "NLNG (babu wannan shafin)") a shekarar ta (2016).[[1]](#cite_note-DW-1)

## Sana’a

[[gyara sashe](/w/index.php?title=Abubakar_Adam_Ibrahim&veaction=edit&section=1 "Gyara sashe: Sana’a") | [gyara masomin](/w/index.php?title=Abubakar_Adam_Ibrahim&action=edit&section=1 "Edit section's source code: Sana’a")]

An kuma haifi Abubakar Adam Ibrahim a [garin Jos](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jos "Jos") dake [Arewa](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Arewa "Arewa") ta tsakiyar [Najeriya](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Najeriya "Najeriya"), kuma ya yi karatun digirinsa na farko a Sadarwar Jama'a a [jami'ar Jos](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jami'ar_Jos "Jami'ar Jos").[[2]](#cite_note-2)

Tarin gajeriyar labarinsa na halarta na farko An Kuma yi jerin *sunayen Bishiyoyi masu*ruɗi don [lambar yabo ta Etisalat don Adabi](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kyautar_Etisalat_na_Adabi?action=edit&redlink=1 "Kyautar Etisalat na Adabi (babu wannan shafin)") a cikin shekarar 2014,[[3]](#cite_note-3) tare da taken da aka zaɓa don [Kyautar Caine don Rubutun Afirka](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kyautar_Caine?action=edit&redlink=1 "Kyautar Caine (babu wannan shafin)").[[4]](#cite_note-4) Kamfanin Buga Littattafai na Cassava Republic ne ya sake buga tarin don a rarraba ƙasa da ƙasa a cikin shekarar 2020[[5]](#cite_note-5) kuma za a buga fassarar Faransanci a cikin shekarar 2022.[[6]](#cite_note-6)

A cikin shekarar (2014) an zaɓe shi a jerin marubutan [Afirka 39](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Afirka39?action=edit&redlink=1 "Afirka39 (babu wannan shafin)") waɗanda shekarunsu ke ƙasa da (40) tare da yuwuwar da hazaƙa don ayyana yanayin gaba a cikin [adabin](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Adabin?action=edit&redlink=1 "Adabin (babu wannan shafin)") [Afirka](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Afirka "Afirka"),[[7]](#cite_note-7)[[8]](#cite_note-8) kuma an saka shi a cikin anthology *Africa39: Sabon Rubuce daga Afirka ta Kudu da Sahara*(ed). [Allahu](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Allah "Allah") Akbar![[9]](#cite_note-9) Ya kasance mai ba da shawara a kan shirin Rubutun( 2013 )kuma ya yi hukunci da [Kyautar Gajerun Rubutattun Labarai](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kyautar_Rubutun_Gajeren_Labari?action=edit&redlink=1 "Kyautar Rubutun Gajeren Labari (babu wannan shafin)") a shekara ta 2014.[[10]](#cite_note-10) Ya kasance shugaban alkalai don lambar yabo ta Etisalat Flash Fiction Prize na 2016.[[11]](#cite_note-11)

Ibrahim ya lashe lambar yabo ta [BBC](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/BBC "BBC") [African](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/African?action=edit&redlink=1 "African (babu wannan shafin)") [Performance Prize](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Performance_Prize?action=edit&redlink=1 "Performance Prize (babu wannan shafin)")[[12]](#cite_note-12) da ANA Plateau/Amatu Braide Prize for Prose. Shi [Gabriel Garcia](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gabriel_Garcia?action=edit&redlink=1 "Gabriel Garcia (babu wannan shafin)") Marquez Fellow (2013),[[13]](#cite_note-13) ɗan Civitella Ranieri (2015)[[14]](#cite_note-14) da( 2018 )Art OMI Fellow.[[15]](#cite_note-:0-15) A cikin shekarar (2016), Ibrahim ya kasance mai karɓar lambar yabo ta [Goethe-Institut](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Goethe-Institut?action=edit&redlink=1 "Goethe-Institut (babu wannan shafin)")& Sylt Foundation [African Writer's Residency Award](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/African_Writer's_Residency_Award?action=edit&redlink=1 "African Writer's Residency Award (babu wannan shafin)") kuma a cikin watan Maris shekarar 2020 ya kasance Abokin Dora Maar.[[16]](#cite_note-16)

Ibrahim ya lashe lambar yabo ta [BBC](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/BBC "BBC") African Performance Prize[[17]](#cite_note-17) da ANA Plateau/Amatu Braide Prize for Prose. Shi Gabriel Garcia Marquez Fellow (2013),[[18]](#cite_note-18) ɗan Civitella Ranieri (2015)[[19]](#cite_note-19) da 2018 Art OMI Fellow.[[15]](#cite_note-:0-15) A cikin shekarar 2016, Ibrahim ya kasance mai karɓar lambar yabo ta [Goethe-Institut](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Goethe-Institut?action=edit&redlink=1 "Goethe-Institut (babu wannan shafin)") & Sylt Foundation African Writer's Residency Award[[20]](#cite_note-20)

# Mansa Musa

**Musa Na** ( c. - c. ), ko **Mansa Musa**, shi ne *Mansa na* goma (wanda ake fassarawa "sultan", "mai nasara" [[1]](#cite_note-1) ko "sarki" ) na Daular Mali, kasar musulman ta Afirka ta yamma.

A lokacin da Musa ya hau kan karagar mulki, ƙasar Mali a bangare dayawa ta kuma ƙunshi yankin tsohuwar daular Ghana wacce kasar Mali ta ci galaba a kanta. Masarautar Mali ta kuma ƙunshi ƙasa wanda yanzu wani ɓangare ne na [Mauritania](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Muritaniya "Muritaniya") da kuma jihar ta [Mali ta zamani](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mali "Mali"). A zamanin mulkinsa, Musa ya riƙe muƙamin da yawa, kamar "Sarkin Melle", "Ubangijin ma'adinan Wangara", kuma "Mai nasara akan Ghanata".

Musa ya ci birane guda 24, tare da garuruwansu. A zamanin mulkin Musa, wataƙila Mali ce ta kasance mai samar da zinari mafi girma a duniya, kuma ana ɗaukar Musa ɗaya daga mutane mafi arziki a tarihi. Koyaya, masu sharhi na zamani irin su mujallar *Time* sun kammala cewa babu ingantacciyar hanyar da za ta ƙayyade arzikin Musa.

Musa gaba ɗaya ana kiransa ne da "Mansa Musa" a cikin rubuce-rubucen yamma da adabi. Sunansa kuma ya bayyana a matsayin "Kankou Musa", "Kankan Musa", "" Kanku Musa ". Sauran sunayen da Musa ya yi amfani da su sun hada da "Mali-Koy Kankan Musa", "Gonga Musa", da "Zakin Mali".

## Zuri'a da kuma kaiwa ga kujeran mulki

[[gyara sashe](/w/index.php?title=Mansa_Musa&veaction=edit&section=1 "Gyara sashe: Zuri'a da kuma kaiwa ga kujeran mulki") | [gyara masomin](/w/index.php?title=Mansa_Musa&action=edit&section=1 "Edit section's source code: Zuri'a da kuma kaiwa ga kujeran mulki")]

Abin da aka sani game da sarakunan masarautar ta Mali an karɓa daga rubuce-rubucen malaman larabawa, waɗanda suka hada da Al-Umari, Abu-sa'id Uthman ad-Dukkali, [Ibn Khaldun](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ibn_Kaldun "Ibn Kaldun"), da [Ibn Battuta](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ibn_Battuta "Ibn Battuta") . Dangane da cikakken tarihin Ibn-Khaldun na sarakunan Mali, kakan Mansa Musa shi ne Abu-Bakr Keita (larabci dai-dai yake da Bakari ko Bogari, sunan asalin da ba'a sani ba - ba [sahabiyy](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sahabban_Annabi "Sahabban Annabi") [Abu Bakr](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Abubakar "Abubakar") ) ba, dan dan Sundiata Keita ne, wanda ya kafa Masarautar Mali kamar yadda aka rubuta ta hanyar labarun baka. Abu-Bakr bai hau gadon sarauta ba, kuma dansa, mahaifin Musa, Faga Laye, ba shi da wata mahimmanci a Tarihin Mali.

Mansa Musa ya kuma hau gadon sarautar ne ta hanyar aiwatar da nadin mataimakin lokacin da wani sarki ya tafi aikin hajjin sa zuwa [Makka](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Makkah "Makkah") ko kuma wani kokarin nasa, daga baya ya nada mataimakin a matsayin magaji. A cewar majiyar farko, an nada Musa mataimakin mataimakin Abubakari Keita II, sarkin da ke gabansa, wanda ya ba da rahoton yawon shakatawa don gano iyakokin [Tekun Atlantika](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tekun_Atalanta "Tekun Atalanta"), kuma bai dawo ba. Masanin Larabawa-Masarautar Al-Umari [[2]](#cite_note-2) ya nakalto Mansa Musa kamar haka:

> Mai mulkin da ya gabace ni bai yi imani da cewa ba zai yiwu a iya kaiwa ga iyakar tekun da ya mamaye duniya (yana nufin Atlantic), kuma yana so ya kai ga ƙarshen, kuma ya ci gaba da nacewa cikin ƙira. Don haka ya wadatar da jiragen ruwa ɗari biyu cike da mutane, kamar yadda sauran da yawa ke cike da zinari, ruwa da abinci isasshen da zai isa shekaru da yawa. Ya kuma umurci shugaban (mai martaba) da kar ya dawo har sai sun kai ƙarshen tekun, ko kuma idan sun ƙosar da abubuwan abinci da ruwan. Sun tashi. Kasancewar ba su tsawan lokaci mai tsawo, kuma, a karshe, jirgin ruwa daya ne ya dawo. A yayin tambayarmu, kyaftin din ya ce: 'Yarima, mun daɗe mun yi ta bincike, har sai da muka gani a tsakiyar teku kamar babban kogi yana guduna da ƙarfi. Jirgin jirgi na shine na karshe; wasu kuma suna gabana. Da zaran wani daga cikinsu ya isa wannan wuri, sai ya nutsar da shi cikin iskar guguwa kuma bai taɓa fitowa ba. Na yi tafiya da baya don tserewa wannan halin. ' Amma Sarkin Musulmi ba zai yarda da shi ba. Ya ba da umarnin a samar musu da jiragen ruwa dubu biyu domin shi da mutanensa, da kuma karin dubu daya domin ruwa da abinci. Sannan ya ba ni labarin gaskiya a lokacin rashi, kuma ya tafi tare da mutanensa a kan balaguron jirgin ruwa, ba zai dawo ba kuma ba alamar rayuwa.

An kuma nada dan Musa magaji, Mansa Magha Keita a matsayin mataimaki a lokacin aikin hajjin Musa.

## Musulunci da aikin hajji zuwa Makkah

[[gyara sashe](/w/index.php?title=Mansa_Musa&veaction=edit&section=2 "Gyara sashe: Musulunci da aikin hajji zuwa Makkah") | [gyara masomin](/w/index.php?title=Mansa_Musa&action=edit&section=2 "Edit section's source code: Musulunci da aikin hajji zuwa Makkah")]

From the far reaches of the [Mediterranean Sea](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mediterranean_Sea?action=edit&redlink=1 "Mediterranean Sea (babu wannan shafin)") to the [Indus River](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Indus_River?action=edit&redlink=1 "Indus River (babu wannan shafin)"), the faithful approached the city of Mecca. All had the same objective to worship together at the most sacred shrine of [Islam](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Islam "Islam"), the [Kaaba](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kaaba "Kaaba") in Mecca. One such traveler was Mansa Musa, [Sultan](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sultan?action=edit&redlink=1 "Sultan (babu wannan shafin)") of [Mali](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mali "Mali") in Western Africa. Mansa Musa had prepared carefully for the long journey he and his attendants would take. He was determined to travel not only for his own religious fulfillment but also for recruiting teachers and leaders so that his realms could learn more of the [Prophet](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Muhammad "Muhammad")'s teachings.

–Mahmud Kati, *Chronicle of the Seeker*

Musa cikakken [Musulmi](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Musulmi "Musulmi") ne mai ibada, [hajjinsa zuwa Makka ya](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Aikin_Hajji "Aikin Hajji") sanya shi sananne a duk faɗin arewacin Afirka da Gabas ta Tsakiya . A wurin Musa, Islama ta kuma kasance "shigowa cikin al'adun duniyar ta gabashin [Bahar Rum](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bahar_Rum "Bahar Rum")". Zai yi amfani da lokaci mai yawa don inganta ci gaban addini a cikin daular sa.

Musa yayi hajjinsa tsakanin shekarar 1324 zuwa 1325. Ya procession rahoto hada 60,000 maza, duk saka kauri da kuma Persian siliki, ciki har da 12,000 bayi, wanda kowane kwashe 4 pounds (1.8 kg) na sandunan zinare, da kuma masu shelanda suna sanye da siliki, wadanda suke ɗaukar sandar zinare, da shirya dawakai, da jakunkuna. Musa ya samar da dukkan abubuwan bukata domin taron, ya ciyar da jama'a gaba daya maza da dabbobi. Waɗannan dabbobin sun haɗa da [raƙuma](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Raƙumi "Raƙumi") 80 waɗanda kowannensu ya ɗauki 50–300 pounds (23–136 kg) ƙurar ƙura. Musa ya ba talakawa zinarin da ya haɗu da su ta hanyar sa. Musa ba kawai ya ba wa biranen da ya bi ta kan hanyar zuwa [Makka ba](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Makkah "Makkah"), ciki har da [Alkahira](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kairo "Kairo") da [Madina](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Madinah "Madinah"), har ma ya yi ciniki da zinare don kyautatuwa. An ruwaito cewa ya gina [masallaci a](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Masallaci "Masallaci") kowace Juma'a.

Shaidun gani da ido da yawa sun tabbatar da tafiyar Musa, yayin da suke kan hanyarsa, waɗanda ke tsoron arzikinsa da tarin yawa, kuma akwai bayanai a wurare da yawa, gami da mujallu, bayanan baka, da kuma tarihai. Musa ya ziyarci Mamluk sultan na Masar, Al-Nasir Muhammad, a Yuli 1324. Duk da irin yanayin da yake bayarwa, dumbin kudaden da Musa ya bayar da gudummawa da yalwa ya janyo da koma baya na zinare tsawon shekaru goma. A cikin biranen Alkahira, Madina, da Makka, kwararar zinare ta bazata ta lalata darajar karfe sosai. Farashin kayayyaki ya yawaita. Wannan kuskuren ya bayyana ga Musa kuma a hanyarsa ta dawowa daga Makka, ya karɓi zinaren da zai iya ɗauka daga masu sayarwa amatsayin bashi da zai biya nan gaba da daraja sosai. Wannan ne kawai lokacin a cikin tarihi cewa mutum ɗaya kai tsaye ya iya sarrafa farashin gwal a cikin Meditareniya . Wasu masana tarihi sun yarda cewa aikin hajji ba shi da wata ma'ana ga addini fiye da mai da hankalin duniya zuwa ga halin da ake ciki a Mali. Irƙirar koma bayan wannan girman yana da ma'ana. Bayan haka, Alkahira shine babbar kasuwar gwal a lokacin (inda mutane suka je siyan dumbin zinare). Don mayar da waɗannan kasuwannin zuwa Timbuktu ko [Gao](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gao_(gari) "Gao (gari)"), Musa da farko ya shafi tattalin arzikin zinare na Alkahira. Duk da yake wannan da'awar yana zama mai shimfiɗa,   Musa sanya wata babbar batu na nuna a kashe ya al'umma dũkiya. Manufar sa shine ya kirkiro wani abu kuma yayi nasara sosai a cikin wannan, har ya sanya kansa da Mali a cikin Atlas na Catalan na 1375. Hakanan yana samun ziyarar daga sananniyar matafiyin duniyar Musulmi, [Ibn Battuta](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ibn_Battuta "Ibn Battuta") .

## Mulki daga baya

[[gyara sashe](/w/index.php?title=Mansa_Musa&veaction=edit&section=4 "Gyara sashe: Mulki daga baya") | [gyara masomin](/w/index.php?title=Mansa_Musa&action=edit&section=4 "Edit section's source code: Mulki daga baya")]

Whenever a hero adds to the list of his exploits from conquest, Mansa Musa gives them a pair of wide trousers...The greater the number of a Dogari's exploits, the bigger the size of his trousers.

–Al-Dukhari, observation of the court of Mansa Musa in [Timbuktu](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Timbuktu "Timbuktu")[[10]](#cite_note-10)

A cikin dogon dawowar sa daga Makka a cikin shekarar 1325, Musa ya ji labari cewa rundunarsa ta kama [Gao](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gao_(gari) "Gao (gari)") . Sagmandia, daya daga cikin janarorinsa ne ya jagoranci ƙoƙarin. Garin Gao yana cikin daular tun kafin mulkin Sakura kuma ya kasance muhimmi - kodayake galibi yan tawaye ne - cibiyar kasuwanci. Musa ya yi shirin ba da agaji ya ziyarci garin da ya karɓi baƙi, 'ya'yan Gao guda biyu, Ali Kolon da Suleiman Nar. Ya koma Niani tare da yaran nan biyu kuma daga baya ya karantar dasu a kotu. Lokacin da Mansa Musa ya dawo, ya dawo da yawancin masanan larabawa da masu gine-gine.

### Gine-gine a ƙasar Mali

[[gyara sashe](/w/index.php?title=Mansa_Musa&veaction=edit&section=5 "Gyara sashe: Gine-gine a ƙasar Mali") | [gyara masomin](/w/index.php?title=Mansa_Musa&action=edit&section=5 "Edit section's source code: Gine-gine a ƙasar Mali")]

Musa ya fara wani babban shiri na gini, yana inganta [masallatai](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Masallaci "Masallaci") da madrasas a Timbuktu da Gao. Mafi mahimmanci, an gina tsohuwar cibiyar koyan Sankore Madrasah (ko Jami'ar Sankore) lokacin mulkinsa.

A Niani, Musa ya gina zauren sauraron ra'ayoyi, wanda yake sadarwa ta ƙofar ciki ta zuwa gidan sarki. Shi ne "mai m Monument", surmounted da wani Dome kuma qawata da arabesques na daukan hankali launuka. Filin katako na katako daga saman bene aka dalaye shi da tsare; na ƙananan bene tare da zinariya. Kamar Babban Masallaci, wani tsayayyen tsari da tsari a Timbuktu, an gina Hall din da dutse ne.

A wannan lokacin, an sami ci gaba na rayuwar birni a cikin manyan cibiyoyin Mali. Sergio Domian, wani masanin kimiyyar zane-zane na Italiya, ya rubuta game da wannan lokacin: "Ta haka kuma aka kafa harsashin wayewar gari. A lokacin da ƙarfinsa ya kasance, Mali tana da aƙalla birane 400, kuma yankin na Niger Delta yana da jama'a sosai. "

### Tattalin arziki da ilimi

[[gyara sashe](/w/index.php?title=Mansa_Musa&veaction=edit&section=6 "Gyara sashe: Tattalin arziki da ilimi") | [gyara masomin](/w/index.php?title=Mansa_Musa&action=edit&section=6 "Edit section's source code: Tattalin arziki da ilimi")]

An kuma rubuta cewa Mansa Musa ya ratsa garuruwan Timbuktu da [Gao](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gao_(gari) "Gao (gari)") a kan hanyarsa ta zuwa [Makka](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Makkah "Makkah"), kuma ya sanya su zama cikin daularsa lokacin da ya dawo a shekara ta 1325. Ya kawo masu zanen kaya daga Andalusia, yanki a Spain, da Alkahira don gina babban fadarsa a Timbuktu da kuma Babban Masallacin Djinguereber da har yanzu yake a yau. [[11]](#cite_note-11)

Ba da daɗewa ba Timbuktu ya zama cibiyar kasuwanci, al'adu, da Musulunci; kasuwannin da aka shigo da su daga kasashen [Hausaland](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hausawa "Hausawa"), Egypt, da sauran masarautun Afirka, an kafa jami'a a cikin gari (haka kuma a garuruwan Mali na Djenné da Ségou ), sannan kuma addinin musulunci ya yadu ta kasuwanni da jami'a, wanda ke sanya Timbuktu wani sabon yanki domin karatuttukan musulinci. [[12]](#cite_note-12) Labarin birnin arziki na daular Maliki har ma ya ratsa tekun Bahar Rum zuwa Kudancin Turai, inda ba da daɗewa ba yan kasuwa daga Venice, [Granada](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Granada "Granada"), da [Genoa](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Genoa "Genoa") sun kara da Timbuktu zuwa taswirar su don siyayya da kayayyaki na zinare. [[13]](#cite_note-13)

Jami'ar Sankore da ke Timbuktu ta kasance ta hannun Musa tare da masana kimiya, da masanan kimiyyar lissafi, da lissafi. Jami'ar ta zama cibiyar koyo da al'adu, tare da jawo hankalin musulmai daga ko'ina cikin Afirka da Gabas ta Tsakiya zuwa Timbuktu.

A shekara ta 1330, masarautar Mossi ta mamaye ta kuma ci birnin Timbuktu. Janar Gao ya riga ya kama Gao, kuma Musa ya hanzarta sake daukar Timbuktu, ya gina shinge da katangar dutse, sannan ya sanya runduna ta tsaro don kare garin daga mamayewa nan gaba. [[14]](#cite_note-14)

Yayin da fadar Musa tun daga lokacin da ta shuɗe, har yanzu jami’ar da masallacin suna tsaye a Timbuktu.

A ƙarshen mulkin Mansa Musa, an canza Sankoré jami'ar zuwa cikakken jami'a wanda ke da mafi yawan tarin littattafai a Afirka tun daga dakin karatu na Alexandria . Jami'ar Sankoré ta iya ɗaliban ɗaliban 25,000 kuma suna da ɗaya daga cikin manyan ɗakunan karatu na duniya tare da rubutun kusan 1,000,000. [[15]](#cite_note-15)

## Mutuwa

[[gyara sashe](/w/index.php?title=Mansa_Musa&veaction=edit&section=7 "Gyara sashe: Mutuwa") | [gyara masomin](/w/index.php?title=Mansa_Musa&action=edit&section=7 "Edit section's source code: Mutuwa")]

Ranar mutuwar Mansa Musa an yi muhawara sosai tsakanin masana tarihi da masana Larabawa waɗanda suka rubuta tarihin ƙasar Mali. Idan aka kwatanta da zamanin magajinsa, dan Mansa Maghan (hukuncin da aka rubuta daga 1337 zuwa 1341) da babban dan'uwan Mansa Suleyman (dokar da aka rubuta daga 1341 zuwa 1360), da kuma tarihin Musa na shekaru 25, ranar da aka kirkiri mutuwarsa 1337. Wasu bayanan sun ce Musa ya yi niyyar kaurace wa dan nasa kursiyin, amma ya mutu ba da daɗewa ba bayan ya dawo daga Makka a 1325. A wani labarin da [Ibn-Khaldun ya ruwaito](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ibn_Kaldun "Ibn Kaldun"), Mansa Musa yana da rai lokacin da aka ci birnin Tlemcen na Aljeriya a shekarar 1337, yayin da ya aiki wakili zuwa Algeria don taya murna ga masu nasara.

# Wikipidiya


**Wikipidiya** [Insakulofidiya](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Insakulofidiya "Insakulofidiya") ce ta kyauta da ke tattare da harsuna daban-daban a faɗin [duniya](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Duniya "Duniya"), wanda al'ummomi masu bada gudummawa ke rubuta mukalai ta hanyar haɗin gwiwa a fili (ba tare da ɓoye-ɓoye ba). A turance a na kiran editocinta da suna ***Wikipedians***. Wikipidiya ta kasance farfajiyar nazari mafi girma a tarihin ilimin duniya.[[1]](#cite_note-1) Ta kasance ɗaya daga cikin fitattun shafukan [yanar gizo](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Yanar_gizo "Yanar gizo") guda goma a duniya kamar yadda Similarweb ta zayyano; izuwa shekara ta 2022 kuwa, Wikipidiya itace ta 7 a cikin jerin fitattun shafuka na yanar gizo a duniya.[[2]](#cite_note-2)[[3]](#cite_note-3)[[4]](#cite_note-4) gidauniyar [Wikimedia Foundation](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikimedia_Foundation "Wikimedia Foundation") ce ke daukan nauyin shafin wikipidiya. ita kuwa **Wikimedia Foundation** wata kungiya ce wanda ba'a samar da riba (wato non-profit organization a Turance) na kasar Amurka, kuma suna samun kudadensu ne ta hanyar taimako/gudummawa (donation) daga wasu kungiyoyi ko [jama'a](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jama'a "Jama'a").[[5]](#cite_note-:0-5)

[Wikipedia](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia_a_harshen_Hausa "Wikipedia a harshen Hausa") shafi ne na [yanar gizo](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Yanar_gizo "Yanar gizo") wanda masu bada gudummawa ke rubuta muƙalai kuma su ke gudanar da ita, ta hanyar shigar da ilimi ko gyare-gyare da sauransu. A Turance ana kuma kiran duk wani mai gyare-gyare ko shigar da [ilimi](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ilimi "Ilimi") a shafukan Wikipedia da suna "[Wikipedian](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedian?action=edit&redlink=1 "Wikipedian (babu wannan shafin)")". Wikipidiya tana tattare da harsunan [duniya](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Duniya "Duniya") da dama, a shafinta kowa na iya ƙirƙira ko gyara muƙala a kyauta domin taimakawa wajen samar da ilimi kyauta, wannan ne yasa wikipidiya tayi zarra a duk duniya wurin samar da ilimi daga asalin inda ilimin ya fito.

Kowa da kowa na da damar bada gudummawa wajen yaɗa ilimi ta hanyar ƙirƙiran sabuwar muƙala ko gyara ƙirƙirarrun muƙalai da ke buƙatan a ingantasu ta hanyar gyara wasu 'yan kura-kurai ko ƙarin bayani. Harwayau babu wani shafi a duniya baki ɗaya da ya tattara ilimi da bayanai a [yanar gizo](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Yanar_gizo "Yanar gizo") a yanzu kamar wikipidiya, kuma miliyoyin ɗalibai ne da malamai, da sauran mutane suke amfana daga manhajar a kullum.

## Tarihi

[[gyara sashe](/w/index.php?title=Wikipidiya&veaction=edit&section=1 "Gyara sashe: Tarihi") | [gyara masomin](/w/index.php?title=Wikipidiya&action=edit&section=1 "Edit section's source code: Tarihi")]

An ƙaddamar da shafin **Wikipidiya** ne a ranar 15 ga watan [Janairun](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Janairu "Janairu") shekara ta 2001, [Jimmy Wales](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jimmy_Wales "Jimmy Wales") tare da [Larry Sanger](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Larry_Sanger "Larry Sanger") ne suka haɗa gwiwa wajen samar da shafin. Suka sanya mata suna ta hanyar hade kalmar *wiki* da *encyclopedia*. A farkon ƙirƙirar shafin an kafa tane da [Turanci](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Turanci "Turanci") kadai amma daga baya sanadiyar karɓuwa da shafin yayi ne yasa ake samar da ƙarin Harsuna akai-akai har zuwa yanzu. A halin yanzu akwai maƙaloli sama da 6,713,721 a sashen Wikipidiya na [Turanci](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Turanci "Turanci") wanda kuma shine sashen da yafi kowanne shahara da tarin maƙaloli. Ayanzu akwai sama da maƙaloli guda miliyan arba'in a mabanbantan yarurruka sama da 301, sannan shafin yana samun masu ziyara mabanbanta sama miliyan 500, adadin duka masu ziyara sunkai sama da biliyan 18 ko wanne wata tun daga watan [Fabrairu](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fabrairu "Fabrairu") na shekara ta 2014.

# Timbuktu


**Timbuktu** birni ne, da ke a yankin Tombouctou, aƙasarn[Mali](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mali "Mali") yammacin Afirka. Jami'ar Sankore da sauran makarantun addinin musulunci ko madrasas suna cikin gari. Garin yana da mahimmanci ga tunani da kuma addini a ƙarni na goma sha’biyar 15 da goma sha’shidda 16. Yana da mahimmanci wajen yada [addinin Musulunci](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Musulunci "Musulunci") ta hanyar [Afirka](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Afirka "Afirka") a wancan lokacin. Akwai manyan [masallatai](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Masallaci "Masallaci") guda uku: Djingareyber, Sankore da Sidi Yahya.Tunatarwa ne game da zamanin zinar Timbuktu. Kullum ana gyara su, amma ana musu barazana saboda hamada tana yaduwa. [[1]](#cite_note-1)

Mutanen Songhay, Abzinawa, Fulani, da na Mandé sune ke zaune a Timbuktu. Shi yana kilomita goma sha’biyar 15 arewa daa [Kogin Neja](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Neja_(kogi) "Neja (kogi)") . Akwai hanya ta [hamadar Sahara](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sahara "Sahara") daga gabas zuwa yamma kuma ana amfani da wannan don kasuwanci . Akwai wani daga arewa zuwa kudu . Waɗannan hanyoyi biyu sun haɗu a Timbuktu. Yana da wani *entrepôt* ga dutse gishiri daga Taoudenni . Wannan yana nufin cewa an kawo gishirin nan kuma a sayar wa wasu mutane su kai shi wani wuri, amma ba a biyan haraji .

Wurin ya taimaka mutane daban-daban sun haɗu, don haka mutanen gida, [Abzinawa](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Abzinawa "Abzinawa") da [Larabawa suka](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Larabawa "Larabawa") haɗu anan. Tana da dogon tarihi na cakuɗa kasuwancin [Afirka](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Afirka "Afirka"), don haka ya zama sananne a [Turai](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Turai "Turai") saboda wannan dalili. Saboda haka, mutanen yamma suna yawan tunanin Timbuktu a matsayin na musamman. Tana da yanayin hamada mai zafi ( *BWh* a cikin ƙirar yanayin Koeppen ).

[Timbuktu ya ba Musulunci](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Musulunci "Musulunci") na duniya damar bincike da nazari. [[2]](#cite_note-2) An rubuta littattafai masu mahimmanci kuma an kwafa su a Timbuktu a cikin ƙarni na 14. Wannan ya sa garin ya zama cibiyar rubutu a [Afirka](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Afirka "Afirka").

# Amurka

*Wannan Muƙalar **guntuwa** ce: tana buƙatar a inganta ta, kuna iya [gyara ta](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Amurka&action=edit).*

Tarihin kafuwar United States of America 🇺🇸

🌍 Asalin farko (kafin Turawa)

Kafin zuwan Turawa, yankin Amurka ya kasance cike da ƙabilun asali (Native Americans) waɗanda suka zauna a wurin tsawon dubban shekaru suna nan.

Sun kasance da al’adu da tsarin rayuwa daban-daban.

🚢 Zuwa Turawa

A shekarar 1492, Christopher Columbus ya isa nahiyar Amurka (duk da bai isa yankin USA kai tsaye ba).

Daga baya Turawa daga ƙasashe kamar England, Spain da Faransa suka fara kafa mazauna a yankin.

🏘️ Mulkin mallaka (Colonies)

Zuwa ƙarni na 17, Ingila ta kafa ƙasashe 13 (Thirteen Colonies) a gabashin Amurka.

Waɗannan yankuna suna ƙarƙashin ikon sarautar Ingila.

⚔️ Yaƙin ‘Yancin Kai

A shekarun 1770s, rikici ya tashi tsakanin mazauna yankin da Ingila saboda haraji da rashin ‘yanci.

Wannan ya kai ga American Revolutionary War.

📜 Sanarwar ‘Yancin Kai

A ranar 4 ga Yuli, 1776, aka fitar da Declaration of Independence.

Jagorori kamar Thomas Jefferson sun rubuta takardar.

Wannan ya nuna cewa yankunan sun balle daga Ingila.

🏛️ Kafuwar ƙasa

Bayan nasara a yaƙi, an kafa sabuwar ƙasa mai suna United States of America.

A shekarar 1787, aka rubuta kundin tsarin mulki (Constitution).

A 1789, George Washington ya zama shugaban ƙasa na farko.

🌎 Faɗaɗa ƙasa

Daga baya Amurka ta faɗaɗa ta hanyar saye da yaƙe-yaƙe.

Ta zama ɗaya daga cikin manyan ƙasashe acikin duniya.

📌 Kammalawa

Kafuwar Amurka ta samo asali ne daga mulkin mallaka na Ingila, zuwa yaƙin neman ‘yanci, sannan ta zama ƙasa mai cikakken iko. Yanzu tana daga cikin ƙasashe mafi ƙarfi a duniya.

# Jami'ar Kimiyya da Fasaha ta Birnin Taipei


**Jami'ar Kimiyya da Fasaha ta Birnin [Taipei](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Taipei "Taipei")** (**TPCU**; Sinanci: 臺北城市科技大學;: ) jami'a ce ta fasaha da ke cikin Gundumar Beitou, Taipei, [Taiwan](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Taiwan "Taiwan") .

Jami'ar tana ba da shirye-shiryen digiri da digiri a fannoni daban-daban, gami da injiniya, kasuwanci, zane, bil'adama, da kimiyyar zamantakewa. An raba shi zuwa kwalejoji shida, wadanda sune Kwalejin Injiniya, Kwalejin Ijiniyan Lantarki da Kimiyya ta Kwamfuta, Kwaleji na Kasuwanci, Kwalejii Zane, Kwalejar Humanities da Kimiyya na Jama'a, da Kwalejin Innovation da Ilimin Kasuwanci.

text: # Fedor Dostoevsky Fedor Dostoevsky 1879 Fedor Dostoevsky Dostoevsky 1863 **Fyodor Mikhailovich**[[lower-alpha 1]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fedor_Dostoevsky#cite_note-1) UK ƙananan-alpha 1 ] ( Birtaniya: / ˌdɒ s US ˈɛfsk i, [1] US: / ˌdɒstə ˈjɛfsk , ˌd ʌ s -/; [[1]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fedor_Dostoevsky#cite_note-2) Russian _Fyódor Mikháylovich Dostoyévskiy_,IPA:[ˈfʲɵdər mʲɪˈxajləvʲɪdʑ dəstɐˈjefskʲɪj]([![Image 55](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/8/8a/Loudspeaker.svg/20px-Loudspeaker.svg.png?utm_source=ha.wikipedia.org&utm_campaign=parser&utm_content=thumbnail)](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fayil:Ru-Dostoevsky.ogg "Game da wannan sauti")[saurare](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/6/64/Ru-Dostoevsky.ogg?utm_source=ha.wikipedia.org&utm_campaign=index&utm_content=original "Ru-Dostoevsky.ogg?utm source=ha.wikipedia.org&utm campaign=index&utm content=original")); 11 ga Nuwamba, 1821–9 Fabrairu 1881 [[lower-alpha 2]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fedor_Dostoevsky#cite_note-3) ), wani lokacin ana fassara shi azaman **Dostoyevsky**, marubuci ne na Rasha, marubucin gajerun labarai, kuma ɗan jarida. Ayyukan adabi na Dostoevsky sun bincika yanayin ɗan adam a cikin rikice-rikice na siyasa, zamantakewa, da ruhi na Rasha na ƙarni na 19, kuma suna aiki tare da jigogi iri-iri na falsafa da na addini. Littattafansa da ya fi yabo sun haɗa da _Laifuka da Hukunci_ (1866), _The Idiot_ (1869), Demons (1872), da _Brothers Karamazov_ (1880). Littafin littafinsa na 1864, _Bayanan kula daga ƙarƙashin ƙasa_, ana ɗaukarsa ɗaya daga cikin ayyukan farko na wallafe-wallafen wanzuwa.[[2]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fedor_Dostoevsky#cite_note-4) Masu sukar adabi da yawa suna ɗaukarsa a matsayin ɗaya daga cikin manyan marubutan marubuta a duk adabin duniya, saboda yawancin ayyukansa ana ɗaukarsa ƙwararru masu tasiri sosai.[[3]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fedor_Dostoevsky#cite_note-FOOTNOTEScanlan2002-5) Fedor Dostoevsky 1859 An haife shi a Moscow a 1821, Dostoevsky an gabatar da shi ga wallafe-wallafe tun yana ƙarami ta hanyar tatsuniyoyi da tatsuniyoyi, kuma ta hanyar littattafai daga marubutan Rasha da na waje. Mahaifiyarsa ta mutu a 1837 lokacin da yake da shekaru 15, kuma a lokaci guda, ya bar makaranta don shiga Cibiyar Injiniya ta Nikolayev . Bayan kammala karatunsa, ya yi aiki a matsayin injiniya kuma ya ɗan more rayuwa mai daɗi, yana fassara littattafai don samun ƙarin kuɗi. A tsakiyar 1840s ya rubuta littafinsa na farko, _Poor Folk_, wanda ya ba shi damar shiga da'irar adabin [Saint Petersburg](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Saint-Petersburg "Saint-Petersburg"). Duk da haka, an kama shi a cikin 1849 don kasancewa cikin ƙungiyar wallafe-wallafen, Petrashevsky Circle, wanda ya tattauna littattafan da aka haramta wa Tsarist Rasha . An yanke wa Dostoevsky hukuncin kisa amma an sassauta hukuncin a karshe . Ya yi shekaru huɗu a sansanin fursuna na Siberiya, sannan ya yi aikin soja na dole na shekara shida a gudun hijira. A cikin shekaru masu zuwa, Dostoevsky ya yi aiki a matsayin ɗan jarida, bugawa da kuma gyara wasu mujallu na kansa kuma daga baya _A Writer's Diary_, tarin rubuce-rubucensa. Ya fara yawo a yammacin Turai kuma ya haɓaka jarabar caca, wanda ya haifar da wahalar kuɗi. Na ɗan lokaci, ya kasance yana roƙon kuɗi, amma a ƙarshe ya zama ɗaya daga cikin marubutan Rasha da aka fi karantawa kuma ana ɗaukansu sosai. Aikin Dostoevsky ya ƙunshi litattafai goma sha uku, litattafai uku, gajerun labarai goma sha bakwai, da sauran ayyuka masu yawa. An karanta rubuce-rubucensa a ko'ina a ciki da bayan ƙasarsa ta Rasha kuma sun yi tasiri daidai da adadi mai yawa na marubuta daga baya ciki har da Rashawa irin su Aleksandr Solzhenitsyn da Anton Chekhov, masana falsafa Friedrich Nietzsche da Jean-Paul Sartre, da bayyanar Existentialism da Freudianism. An fassara littattafansa zuwa fiye da harsuna 170, kuma sun zama abin ƙarfafawa ga fina-finai da yawa. ## Zuri'a [[gyara sashe](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Fedor_Dostoevsky&veaction=edit§ion=1 "Gyara sashe: Zuri'a") | [gyara masomin](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Fedor_Dostoevsky&action=edit§ion=1 "Edit section's source code: Zuri'a")] Kakannin kakannin Dostoevsky sun kasance ɓangare na dangi mai daraja na Kiristocin Orthodox na Rasha. Iyalin sun samo asalinsu zuwa Danilo Irtishch, wanda aka ba da filaye a cikin yankin Pinsk (tsawon ƙarni na wani ɓangare na Grand Duchy na Lithuania, yanzu a [Belarus](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Belarus "Belarus") na zamani) a cikin 1509 don ayyukansa a ƙarƙashin wani yarima na gida, zuriyarsa sa'an nan kuma ya dauki. Sunan "Dostoevsky" bisa wani ƙauye da ake kira Dostoïevo (wanda aka samo daga Tsohon Yaren mutanen Poland _dostojnik_ - mai daraja).[[4]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fedor_Dostoevsky#cite_note-6) Kakannin Dostoevsky na nan da nan a gefen mahaifiyarsa sun kasance 'yan kasuwa; Namijin na wajen mahaifinsa firistoci ne. [[5]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fedor_Dostoevsky#cite_note-FOOTNOTEKjetsaa1989-7)[[6]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fedor_Dostoevsky#cite_note-FOOTNOTEFrank1979-8) A 1809, Mikhail Dostoevsky dan shekaru 20 da haihuwa shiga a Moscow ta Imperial Medical-Surgical Academy. Daga nan aka sanya shi zuwa asibitin Moscow, inda ya yi aiki a matsayin likita na soja, kuma a 1818 ya nada babban likita. A 1819 ya auri Maria Nechayeva. A shekara ta gaba, ya ɗauki matsayi a asibitin Mariinsky don matalauta. A shekara ta 1828, sa’ad da ’ya’yansa biyu, Mikhail da Fyodor, suka kasance takwas da bakwai, sai aka ƙara masa girma zuwa ma’aikacin tantance koleji, matsayin da ya ɗaga matsayinsa na shari’a zuwa na manyan mutane kuma ya ba shi damar mallakar ƙaramin gida a Darovoye, wani gari. kusan 150 kilomita (mil 100) daga Moscow, inda iyali sukan yi lokacin bazara. [[5]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fedor_Dostoevsky#cite_note-FOOTNOTEKjetsaa1989-7) Iyayen Dostoevsky daga baya sun sami ƙarin 'ya'ya shida: Varvara (1822-1892), Andrei (1825-1897), Lyubov (an haife shi kuma ya mutu 1829), Vera (1829-1896), Nikolai (1831-1883) da Aleksandra (1835). -1889). [[5]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fedor_Dostoevsky#cite_note-FOOTNOTEKjetsaa1989-7)[[6]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fedor_Dostoevsky#cite_note-FOOTNOTEFrank1979-8) ## Yarinta (1821-1836) [[gyara sashe](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Fedor_Dostoevsky&veaction=edit§ion=2 "Gyara sashe: Yarinta (1821-1836)") | [gyara masomin](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Fedor_Dostoevsky&action=edit§ion=2 "Edit section's source code: Yarinta (1821-1836)")] Dostoevsky 1876 Fyodor Dostoevsky, an haife shi a ranar 11 Nuwamba a Moscow, shi ne ɗa na biyu na Dr. Mikhail Dostoevsky da Maria Dostoevskaya (haife Nechayeva). Ya girma a cikin gidan iyali a cikin filin Mariinsky Hospital for Poor, wanda yake a cikin ƙananan yanki a gefen Moscow. [[7]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fedor_Dostoevsky#cite_note-FOOTNOTEBloom2004-9) Dostoevsky ya sadu da marasa lafiya, waɗanda suke a ƙarshen ma'auni na zamantakewa na Rasha, lokacin da suke wasa a cikin lambunan asibiti. [[8]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fedor_Dostoevsky#cite_note-FOOTNOTEBreger2008-10) Dostoevsky an gabatar da shi ga wallafe-wallafe tun yana ƙarami. Tun yana da shekaru uku, an karanta shi labarin jarumtaka, tatsuniyoyi da tatsuniyoyi daga mahaifiyarsa, Alena Frolovna, wani mutum mai tasiri musamman a cikin tarbiyyarsa da kuma son labarun almara. [[9]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fedor_Dostoevsky#cite_note-FOOTNOTELeatherbarrow2002-11) Sa’ad da yake ɗan shekara huɗu mahaifiyarsa ta yi amfani da Littafi Mai Tsarki wajen koya masa karatu da rubutu. Iyayensa sun gabatar da shi ga wallafe-wallafe masu yawa, ciki har da marubutan Rasha Karamzin, Pushkin da Derzhavin; Almarar Gothic irin su ayyukan daga marubuci Ann Radcliffe; ayyukan soyayya na Schiller da Goethe; labarun jaruntaka na Miguel de Cervantes da Walter Scott; da [almara](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wa%C6%99ar_almara "Waƙar almara") na [Homer](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Homer "Homer"). [[5]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fedor_Dostoevsky#cite_note-FOOTNOTEKjetsaa1989-7)[[6]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fedor_Dostoevsky#cite_note-FOOTNOTEFrank1979-8) Dostoevsky ya sami tasiri sosai da aikin Nikolai Gogol . Ko da yake an bayyana tsarin mahaifinsa a matsayin mai tsauri da tsauri, [[10]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fedor_Dostoevsky#cite_note-FOOTNOTEMochulsky1967-12) Dostoevsky da kansa ya ruwaito cewa iyayensa sun kawo tunaninsa ta hanyar karatun dare. [[8]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fedor_Dostoevsky#cite_note-FOOTNOTEBreger2008-10) Wasu abubuwan da ya faru a yarinta sun sami hanyar shiga cikin rubuce-rubucensa. Sa’ad da wani mashayi ya yi wa wata yarinya ‘yar shekara tara fyade, aka ce ya kawo mahaifinsa ya yi mata hidima. Abin da ya faru ya damu da shi, kuma jigon sha'awar wani balagagge ga yarinya ya bayyana a _cikin Shaidanun_, _Brothers Karamazov_, _Laifuka da azabtarwa_, da sauran rubuce-rubuce. [[11]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fedor_Dostoevsky#cite_note-FOOTNOTELantz2004-13) Wani abin da ya faru da wani bawa na iyali, ko serf, a cikin ƙasa a Darovoye, an kwatanta shi a cikin " The Peasant Marey ": lokacin da matashin Dostoevsky ya yi tunanin jin kullun a cikin daji, Marey, wanda ke aiki a kusa, yana ƙarfafa shi. Ko da yake Dostoevsky yana da tsarin tsarin jiki mai laushi, iyayensa sun bayyana shi a matsayin mai zafi, taurin kai, da kuma kunci. [[5]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fedor_Dostoevsky#cite_note-FOOTNOTEKjetsaa1989-7) A cikin 1833, mahaifin Dostoevsky, wanda yake da zurfin addini, ya tura shi makarantar kwana ta Faransa sannan zuwa makarantar kwana ta Chermak. An bayyana shi a matsayin kodadde, mai mafarkin shiga ciki kuma mai yawan jin daɗin soyayya. [[5]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fedor_Dostoevsky#cite_note-FOOTNOTEKjetsaa1989-7) Don biyan kuɗin makaranta, mahaifinsa ya ranci kuɗi kuma ya tsawaita aikin likita na sirri. Dostoevsky ya ji ba shi da wuri a cikin 'yan makarantarsa masu daraja a makarantar Moscow, kuma an nuna kwarewa a cikin wasu ayyukansa, musamman _The Adolescent_ . [[5]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fedor_Dostoevsky#cite_note-FOOTNOTEKjetsaa1989-7)[[6]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fedor_Dostoevsky#cite_note-FOOTNOTEFrank1979-8) ## Samarta (1836-1843) [[gyara sashe](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Fedor_Dostoevsky&veaction=edit§ion=3 "Gyara sashe: Samarta (1836-1843)") | [gyara masomin](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Fedor_Dostoevsky&action=edit§ion=3 "Edit section's source code: Samarta (1836-1843)")] Dostoevsky a matsayin injiniyan soja An ranar 27 Satumba 1837 Mahaifiyar Dostoevsky ta mutu da [tarin fuka](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tibi "Tibi"). A watan Mayun da ya gabata, iyayensa sun aika Dostoevsky da ɗan'uwansa Mikhail zuwa Saint Petersburg don halartar Cibiyar Injiniya ta Soja ta Nikolayev kyauta, ta tilasta 'yan'uwa su watsar da karatunsu na ilimi don aikin soja. Dostoevsky shiga makarantar kimiyya a Janairu 1838, amma kawai tare da taimakon 'yan uwa. An ki yarda da Mikhail saboda dalilai na kiwon lafiya kuma an aika shi zuwa makarantar kimiyya a [Reval](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tallinn "Tallinn") (yanzu Tallinn, Estonia). [[5]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fedor_Dostoevsky#cite_note-FOOTNOTEKjetsaa1989-7)[[6]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fedor_Dostoevsky#cite_note-FOOTNOTEFrank1979-8) Dostoevsky ba ya son makarantar, musamman saboda rashin sha'awar kimiyya, lissafi, da injiniyanci na soja da kuma fifikon zane da gine-gine. Kamar yadda abokinsa Konstantin Trutovsky ya taɓa cewa, “Babu wani ɗalibi a cikin duka jami’ar da ke da ƙarancin aikin soja kamar FM Dostoevsky. Ya motsa a dunkule da firgita; Unifom ɗin sa ya rataye shi da kyar; da jakarsa, da [[11]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fedor_Dostoevsky#cite_note-FOOTNOTELantz2004-13) da bindigar duk sun yi kama da wani nau'i na sarƙoƙi da aka tilasta masa sa na ɗan lokaci, kuma waɗanda suka yi masa yawa." da kuma tsananin adalci, kare sabbin shiga, ya hada kansa da malamai, ya soki cin hanci da rashawa a tsakanin jami’an, da taimakawa manoma marasa galihu. Ko da yake shi kaɗai ne kuma yana zaune a duniyarsa ta adabi, abokan karatunsa suna girmama shi. Kasancewarsa da sha'awar addini ya sa ake masa lakabi da "Monk Photius ". [[5]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fedor_Dostoevsky#cite_note-FOOTNOTEKjetsaa1989-7)[[6]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fedor_Dostoevsky#cite_note-FOOTNOTEFrank1979-8) Alamun farfadiya Dostoevsky na iya fara bayyana ne a lokacin da ake sanin mutuwar mahaifinsa a ranar 16 ga Yuni 1839, [[12]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fedor_Dostoevsky#cite_note-FOOTNOTESekirin1997-14) ko da yake rahotannin kamawa sun samo asali ne daga asusun da 'yarsa ta rubuta (daga baya Sigmund Freud ya fadada shi [[13]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fedor_Dostoevsky#cite_note-15) wanda yanzu ya kasance. dauke da rashin dogara. Dalilin mutuwar mahaifinsa a hukumance shine bugun jini, amma wani makwabcinsa Pavel Khotiaintsev ya zargi barayin mahaifin da kisan kai. Da a ce an sami masu laifin da aka aika su Siberiya, Khotiaintsev zai kasance a cikin matsayi don siyan ƙasar da aka bari. An wanke masu laifin a cikin shari'a a Tula, amma ɗan'uwan Dostoevsky Andrei ya ci gaba da labarin. [[11]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fedor_Dostoevsky#cite_note-FOOTNOTELantz2004-13) Bayan mutuwar mahaifinsa, Dostoevsky ya ci gaba da karatunsa, ya ci jarrabawarsa kuma ya sami digiri na injiniya, ya ba shi damar zama daga makarantar. Ya ziyarci Mikhail a cikin Reval (Tallinn) kuma yakan halarci kide-kide, wasan kwaikwayo, wasan kwaikwayo da ballets. A wannan lokacin, abokansa biyu sun gabatar da shi game da caca. [[5]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fedor_Dostoevsky#cite_note-FOOTNOTEKjetsaa1989-7)[[6]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fedor_Dostoevsky#cite_note-FOOTNOTEFrank1979-8) Fedor Dostoevsky A ranar 12 ga Agusta 1843 Dostoevsky ya ɗauki aiki a matsayin Laftanar Injiniya kuma ya zauna tare da Adolph Totleben a wani gida mallakar Dr. Rizenkampf, abokin Mikhail. Rizenkampf ya siffanta shi da cewa "ba shi da halin kirki kuma ba shi da ladabi fiye da ɗan'uwansa, amma idan ba a cikin yanayi mai kyau ba yakan kalli komai ta gilashin duhu, ya zama mai ban sha'awa, ya manta da kyawawan dabi'u, wani lokacin kuma ana kai shi zuwa ga ma'ana. zagi da rashin sanin kai”. [[6]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fedor_Dostoevsky#cite_note-FOOTNOTEFrank1979-8) Dostoevsky na farko kammala aikin adabi, fassarar littafin Honoré de Balzac na _Eugénie Grandet_, an buga shi a watan Yuni da Yuli 1843 a cikin 6th da 7th kundin mujallolin _Repertoire da Pantheon_, [[8]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fedor_Dostoevsky#cite_note-FOOTNOTEBreger2008-10) ya biyo baya da yawa. sauran fassarorin. Babu wanda ya yi nasara, kuma matsalar kuɗinsa ta sa shi ya rubuta labari. # Wikipedia a harshen Hausa

_Wannan Muƙalar **guntuwa** ce: tana buƙatar a inganta ta, kuna iya [gyara ta](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Wikipedia\_a\_harshen\_Hausa&action=edit)._

## Gabatarwa

[[gyara sashe](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Wikipedia_a_harshen_Hausa&veaction=edit&section=1 "Gyara sashe: Gabatarwa") | [gyara masomin](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Wikipedia_a_harshen_Hausa&action=edit&section=1 "Edit section's source code: Gabatarwa")]

# David Boren

**David Lyle Boren** (21 ga Afrilu, 1941 - 20 ga Fabrairu, 2025) lauya ne kuma ɗan siyasa ɗan Amurka daga [Oklahoma](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Oklahoma "Oklahoma") . Ɗan jam'iyyar Democrat ne, ya yi aiki a matsayin gwamna na 21 na Oklahoma daga 1975 zuwa 1979 da kuma wa'adi uku a Majalisar Dattawan Amurka daga 1979 zuwa 1994. Dan jam'iyyar Democrat mai ra'ayin mazan jiya, har zuwa yau, shi ne na ƙarshe a cikin jam'iyyarsa da ya yi aiki a matsayin Sanatan Amurka daga Oklahoma. Shi ne shugaban Jami'ar Oklahoma na 13 kuma na biyu mafi daɗewa a jere daga 1994 zuwa 2018. Shi ne shugaban Kwamitin Zaɓen Majalisar Dattawa kan Leƙen Asiri . A ranar 20 ga Satumba, 2017, Boren ya sanar da yin ritayarsa a hukumance a matsayin shugaban Jami'ar Oklahoma, wanda ya fara aiki a ranar 30 ga Yuni, 2018.

## Rayuwar farko da ilimi

[[gyara sashe](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=David_Boren&veaction=edit&section=1 "Gyara sashe: Rayuwar farko da ilimi") | [gyara masomin](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=David_Boren&action=edit&section=1 "Edit section's source code: Rayuwar farko da ilimi")]

An haifi Boren a [Washington, DC](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Washington,_D.C. "Washington, D.C."), a ranar 21 ga Afrilu, 1941, ga Christine (née McKown) da kuma tsohuwar wakiliyar Amurka Lyle Hagler Boren . Ya halarci makarantun gwamnati a Seminole, Oklahoma da Bethesda, Maryland. [[1]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/David_Boren#cite_note-EOHC-1) Daga baya ya kammala karatunsa a shekarar 1963 daga Jami'ar Yale, inda ya yi digiri a tarihin Amurka, ya kammala karatunsa a cikin mafi girman kashi ɗaya cikin ɗari na ajinsa kuma aka zaɓe shi zuwa Phi Beta Kappa . [[2]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/David_Boren#cite_note-2) Ya kasance memba na Jam'iyyar Conservative ta Yale, Cannon da Castle ROTC Honor Society, an zaɓe shi shugaban ƙungiyar siyasa ta Yale kuma memba ne na Skull and Bones . An zaɓe shi a matsayin [Rhodes Scholar](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tallafin_karatu_na_Rhodes "Tallafin karatu na Rhodes") kuma ya sami digiri na biyu a Falsafa, Siyasa, da Tattalin Arziki daga [Jami'ar Oxford](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jami'ar_Oxford "Jami'ar Oxford") (1965). A shekarar 1968, ya sami digiri na JD daga Kwalejin Shari'a ta Jami'ar Oklahoma . [[1]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/David_Boren#cite_note-EOHC-1)

## Majalisar Wakilai ta Oklahoma

[[gyara sashe](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=David_Boren&veaction=edit&section=2 "Gyara sashe: Majalisar Wakilai ta Oklahoma") | [gyara masomin](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=David_Boren&action=edit&section=2 "Edit section's source code: Majalisar Wakilai ta Oklahoma")]

A shekarar 1966, Boren ya kayar da abokin takararsa na jam'iyyar Democrat William C. Wantland a zaben fidda gwani da kuma Clifford Conn Jr. a babban zaben don lashe kujera a Majalisar Wakilai ta Oklahoma . Ya yi wa'adi hudu, daga 1967 zuwa 1974. [[1]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/David_Boren#cite_note-EOHC-1)

A lokacin da yake aiki a Majalisar, Boren memba ne na kwamitin da ya binciki Jami'ar Oklahoma bayan da makarantar ta ba wa bakar fata mai fafutukar kare haƙƙin jama'a Paul Boutelle, wani mai fafutukar kare haƙƙin jama'a kuma mai adawa da Yaƙin Vietnam, damar yin jawabi a can. [ an buƙata ambato ] A lokacin da yake Majalisar Wakilai, Boren shi ma farfesa ne a Jami'ar Baptist ta Oklahoma .

## Rayuwar mutum da mutuwa

[[gyara sashe](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=David_Boren&veaction=edit&section=3 "Gyara sashe: Rayuwar mutum da mutuwa") | [gyara masomin](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=David_Boren&action=edit&section=3 "Edit section's source code: Rayuwar mutum da mutuwa")]

Boren ya yi aure sau biyu. Aurensa na farko da Janna Little, 'yar Reuel Little, ya faru ne jim kaɗan bayan kammala karatunsa a shekarar 1968. Sun haifi 'ya'ya biyu, kuma sun sake a shekarar 1976. Ya auri Alkali Molly Shi, Alkalin Gundumar Musamman ta Pontotoc County a ranar 27 ga Nuwamba, 1977. Wannan shine karo na farko da wani Gwamna a Oklahoma ya yi aure yayin da yake kan mulki. Shi 'yar asalin Ada, Oklahoma ce kuma ɗalibiyar Jami'ar East Central da Jami'ar Oklahoma, inda ta sami digirinta na shari'a. Ta kasance lauya a fannin aiki na sirri tsawon shekaru biyu kafin a naɗa ta alkali. [[1]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/David_Boren#cite_note-EOHC-1)

# Ibezito Ogbonna


**Ibe Zito Ogbonna** (an haife shi a ranar 27 ga watan Maris ɗin shekarar 1983, a [Sokoto](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sokoto_(birni) "Sokoto (birni)"), [Najeriya](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Najeriya "Najeriya")) tsohon ɗan wasan [ƙwallon ƙafa](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kungiyar_Kwallon_Kafa "Kungiyar Kwallon Kafa") ne na Najeriya wanda ke zaune a Ashdod, Isra'ila.

## Sana'ar wasa

[[gyara sashe](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Ibezito_Ogbonna&veaction=edit&section=1 "Gyara sashe: Sana'ar wasa") | [gyara masomin](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Ibezito_Ogbonna&action=edit&section=1 "Edit section's source code: Sana'ar wasa")]

Zito ya bugawa Hapoel Tel Aviv daga shekarar 2003 zuwa 2007. A cikin shekaru huɗu ya sami damar ci gaba da riƙe matsayinsa na 'sarkin kwallaye' na kulob ɗin.

Bayan ya shafe shekaru huɗu a [Isra'ila](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Isra'ila "Isra'ila") tare da Hapoel Tel Aviv, Ogbonna ya sanya hannu kan kwangilar shekaru uku tare da CFR Cluj a Romania.

Ya kuma samu buga wasanni biyu ne kawai ga ƴan ƙasar Romania, duk da cewa ya samu rauni a farkon kakar wasa ta bana, wanda hakan ya sa ya yi jinyar shekara guda. Daga nan sai aka sake Ogbonna akan kyauta ta CFR Cluj.

Ya rattaɓa hannu a kulob ɗin [Kaizer Chiefs](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/%C6%98ungiyar_%C6%99wallon_kafa_ta_Kaizer_Chiefs "Ƙungiyar ƙwallon kafa ta Kaizer Chiefs") na Premier League a cikin watan Nuwamban 2008. A cikin watan Janairun shekarar 2012 zai je tattaunawa da FK Vardar. Ya sanya hannu tare da FK Vardar Skopje a ranar 31 ga watan Janairu.

Ya koma [Isra'ila](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Isra'ila "Isra'ila") a cikin shekarar 2017.

title: 1942 (wasan bidiyo)
text: # 1942 (wasan bidiyo) _**1942**_ wasa ne na bidiyo mai harbi na tsaye na 1984 wanda Capcom ya haɓaka kuma ya buga don ɗakunan wasan kwaikwayo. Yoshiki Okamoto ne ya tsara shi, shi ne wasan farko a cikin Jerin 194X, kuma 1943: Yakin Midway ya biyo baya. _1942_ an saita shi a cikin [Gidan wasan kwaikwayo na Pacific](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Yakin_Pacific "Yakin Pacific") na [Yaƙin Duniya na II](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ya%C6%99in_Duniya_na_II "Yaƙin Duniya na II"), kuma ya dogara ne akan Yaƙin Midway . Duk da cewa masu haɓaka na Japan ne suka kirkirar wasan, burin shine ya isa [Tokyo](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tokyo "Tokyo") kuma ya lalata jirgin saman Japan; wannan ya kasance saboda kasancewa wasan Capcom na farko da aka tsara tare da kasuwannin Yamma a zuciya. Ya ci gaba da zama nasarar kasuwanci a cikin gidan caca, ya zama wasan kwaikwayo na biyar mafi girma na Japan na 1986 kuma ɗaya daga cikin manyan kayan jujjuyawar gidan caca guda biyar a wannan shekarar a Amurka. An tura shi zuwa Nintendo Entertainment System, yana sayar da fiye da miliyan 1 a duk duniya, tare da sauran tsarin gida. ## Wasanni [[gyara sashe](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=1942_(wasan_bidiyo)&veaction=edit§ion=1 "Gyara sashe: Wasanni") | [gyara masomin](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=1942_(wasan_bidiyo)&action=edit§ion=1 "Edit section's source code: Wasanni")] [Fayil:ARC 1942 (Midway - Last 32 Stage).png](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/Special:UploadWizard?uselang=ha&wpDestFile=ARC_1942_(Midway_-_Last_32_Stage).png "Fayil:ARC 1942 (Midway - Last 32 Stage).png") Hoton hoton Arcade Mai kunnawa yana tuka Lockheed P-38 Lightning wanda ake kira "Super Ace". Mai kunnawa dole ne ya harbe jiragen saman abokan gaba kuma ya guje wa wuta ta abokan gaba: sau ɗaya a cikin jirgin ko haɗuwa da wani jirgin sama yana haifar da asarar rai ɗaya. A lokacin wasan, mai kunnawa na iya tattara jerin abubuwan da ke motsawa, ɗaya daga cikinsu yana ba da damar wasu ƙananan mayakan biyu su raka jirgin a cikin tsarin Tip Tow. Maƙiyan sun haɗa da: Kawasaki Ki-61s, Mitsubishi A6M Zeros da Kawasaki Ki-48s. Jirgin saman shi ne Nakajima G10N . Wasan yana da "maɓallin juyawa na musamman wanda ke bawa 'yan wasa damar kauce wa yanayi mai haɗari ta hanyar yin amfani da ɗan lokaci daga" filin wasa. Baya ga daidaitattun maki, yana da kashi daban-daban, yana yin rikodin mafi kyawun rabo na mayakan abokan gaba ga abokan gaba da aka harbe. ## Manazarta [[gyara sashe](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=1942_(wasan_bidiyo)&veaction=edit§ion=2 "Gyara sashe: Manazarta") | [gyara masomin](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=1942_(wasan_bidiyo)&action=edit§ion=2 "Edit section's source code: Manazarta")] Daga "[https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=1942_(wasan_bidiyo)&oldid=699247](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=1942_(wasan_bidiyo)&oldid=699247)" [Rukunoni](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Musamman:Categories "Musamman:Categories"): * [Articles with hAudio microformats](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rukuni:Articles_with_hAudio_microformats "Rukuni:Articles with hAudio microformats") * [Shafuka masu hade-hade](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rukuni:Shafuka_masu_hade-hade "Rukuni:Shafuka masu hade-hade") * Anyi gyaran ƙarshe na wannan shafi a ranar 13 ga Augusta, 2025, da ƙarfe 19:03. * An gabatar da shafin da [Parsoid](https://www.mediawiki.org/wiki/Special:MyLanguage/Parsoid "mw:Special:MyLanguage/Parsoid"). * An samar da muƙaloli a ƙarƙashin lasisin [Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike License](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/); mai yiwuwa da kwai sauran sharudda. **_Amanita_ phalloides**_(/æməˈnaɪtə pawnˈlɔɪdiːz/ am-ə-NITE-ə pawn-LOYD-eez), wanda aka fi sani da **murfin mutuwa**, ƙwayoyin cuta ne masu guba da ƙwayoyin ƙwayoyin halitta, ɗaya daga cikin da yawa a cikin jinsin Amanita. Ya samo asali ne a Turai [[1]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Amanita\_phalloides#cite\_note-1) amma daga baya aka gabatar da shi zuwa wasu sassan duniya tun daga ƙarshen karni na ashirin, [[2]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Amanita\_phalloides#cite\_note-Litten75-2)[[3]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Amanita\_phalloides#cite\_note-MedJAus1993-3)[[4]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Amanita\_phalloides#cite\_note-Kurtziana1983-4)_ A. phalloides _ya samar da ectomycorrhizas tare da itatuwa daban-daban.[[5]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Amanita\_phalloides#cite\_note-5) A wasu lokuta, an gabatar da murfin mutuwa zuwa sabbin yankuna tare da noman nau'ikan itacen oak, chestnut, da Pine. Manyan jikin 'ya'yan itace suna bayyana a lokacin rani da kaka; ƙwanƙolin suna da launin kore tare da fararen stipe da gills. Launi na murfin yana da bambanci, gami da fararen siffofi, don haka ba abin dogaro ba ne._

Wadannan ƙwayoyin ƙwayoyin cuta suna kama da nau'ikan da za a iya cinyewa da yawa (musamman ƙwayoyin Kaisar da ƙwayoyin ciyawa) waɗanda mutane ke cinyewa, suna ƙara haɗarin guba ta haɗari. Amatoxins, nau'in guba da aka samu a cikin waɗannan ƙwayoyin, suna da tsayayya da zafi: suna tsayayya le canje-canje saboda zafi da sanyi, don haka tasirin su mai guba ba a rage su ta hanyar dafa ko daskarewa ba.

## Tarihin lissafi

[[gyara sashe](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Amanita_phalloides&veaction=edit&section=1 "Gyara sashe: Tarihin lissafi") | [gyara masomin](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Amanita_phalloides&action=edit&section=1 "Edit section's source code: Tarihin lissafi")]

An sanya sunan murfin mutuwa a cikin [Latin](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Harshen_Latin "Harshen Latin") kamar haka a cikin wasiku tsakanin likitan Ingila [Thomas Browne](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Thomas_Browne?action=edit&redlink=1 "Thomas Browne (babu wannan shafin)") da [Christopher Merrett](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Christopher_Merrett?action=edit&redlink=1 "Christopher Merrett (babu wannan shafin)") . Masanin tsire-tsire na Faransa [Sébastien Vaillant](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/S%C3%A9bastien_Vaillant?action=edit&redlink=1 "Sébastien Vaillant (babu wannan shafin)") ne [An bayyana shi](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Species_description?action=edit&redlink=1 "Species description (babu wannan shafin)") a cikin 1727, wanda ya ba da ɗan gajeren kalma mai suna "Fungus phalloides, annulatus, sordide virescens, et patulus" (shaped phallus, ring-stemmed, dirty green mushroom tare da babban 'spreading' cap.p).
