# Buta

**Buta**, wani lokaci ana kiransa da **tea kettle** ko **teakettle**, wata na'ura ce da aka ƙera don tafasa ruwa, yawanci tana da _murfi_, _magudanar ruwa_, da _zare_. Akwai nau'ikan guda biyu: _stovetop buta_, wanda ke amfani da zafi daga [hob](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cooktop?action=edit&redlink=1 "Cooktop (babu wannan shafin)"), da _electric buta_, wanda wani [karamin](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Small_appliance?action=edit&redlink=1 "Small appliance (babu wannan shafin)")[na'ura](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kitchen_appliance?action=edit&redlink=1 "Kitchen appliance (babu wannan shafin)") ce tare da [na'ura mai zafi](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Heating_element?action=edit&redlink=1 "Heating element (babu wannan shafin)") a ciki.

**Buta:** wani abu ne da ake amfani da shi wajen ɗaukar ruwa ko kuma wankan tsarki, ana kuma amfani da shi wajen wanke hannu da fuska.

## Etymology

[[gyara sashe](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Buta&veaction=edit&section=1 "Gyara sashe: Etymology") | [gyara masomin](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Buta&action=edit&section=1 "Edit section's source code: Etymology")]

Kalmar _buta_ ta samo asali ne daga tsohuwar harshen Norse _ketill_, "[cauldron](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cauldron?action=edit&redlink=1 "Cauldron (babu wannan shafin)")". Rubutun Tsohon Ingilishi shine _cetel_ tare da farkon _che-_ [tʃ] kamar 'cherry', Middle English (da kuma yare) shine _chetel_, duk sun fito (tare da Jamusanci _Kessel_ "cauldron") daga Germanic _*katilaz_, wanda aka aro daga Latin _catillus_, ƙaramin nau'i na _catinus_ "tukunyar zurfi don hidima ko dafa abinci",[[1]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Buta#cite_note-1) wanda a cikin mahallin daban-daban ake fassara shi da "kwano", "tukunyar zurfi", ko "rariya".

## Stovetop butas

[[gyara sashe](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Buta&veaction=edit&section=2 "Gyara sashe: Stovetop butas") | [gyara masomin](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Buta&action=edit&section=2 "Edit section's source code: Stovetop butas")]


A [stovetop](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Stovetop?action=edit&redlink=1 "Stovetop (babu wannan shafin)") buta on a [gas burner](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gas_burner?action=edit&redlink=1 "Gas burner (babu wannan shafin)"); this type, without a lid, is filled through the spout.

buta na zamani na stovetop wani tukunyar ƙarfe ce tare da ƙasa madaidaiciya da ake amfani da ita don dumama ruwa akan [stovetop ko hob](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Stovetop?action=edit&redlink=1 "Stovetop (babu wannan shafin)"). Yawanci suna da zare a saman, magudanar ruwa, da murfi. Wasu kuma suna da wani [kukin tururi](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Whistle?action=edit&redlink=1 "Whistle (babu wannan shafin)") wanda ke nuna lokacin da ruwan ya kai ga tafasa. Ana yin butas yawanci da [stainless steel](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Stainless_steel?action=edit&redlink=1 "Stainless steel (babu wannan shafin)") amma kuma ana iya yin su daga tagulla ko wasu ƙarfe.

## Electric butas

[[gyara sashe](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Buta&veaction=edit&section=3 "Gyara sashe: Electric butas") | [gyara masomin](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Buta&action=edit&section=3 "Edit section's source code: Electric butas")]


An electric buta , with boiling water visible in its transparent water chamber

A kasashe da ke da wutar lantarki 200–240 V, ana amfani da butas na lantarki sosai don tafasa ruwa ba tare da bukatar murhu ba. Ana rufe na'urar dumama gaba ɗaya, tare da ƙimar ƙarfin wuta na 2–3 kW. Wannan yana nufin cewa ana ɗaukar wutar lantarki har zuwa 13 A, wanda yake da ƙima mai yawa daga cikin wutar da ake samu a yawancin gidaje: [babban fuse](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fuse_(electrical)?action=edit&redlink=1 "Fuse (electrical) (babu wannan shafin)") na yawancin gidaje yana tsakanin 20 da 100 amps. A kasashe da ke da wutar lantarki 120 V, ana ɗaukar sau biyu na wutar lantarki don samun ƙarfin wuta iri ɗaya.[[2]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Buta#cite_note-2)

A cikin ƙira na zamani, da zarar ruwan ya kai ga tafasa, buta ɗin yana kashe kansa ta atomatik, yana hana ruwan tafasa har ya ƙare kuma ya lalata na'urar dumama.

### Bincike

[[gyara sashe](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Buta&veaction=edit&section=4 "Gyara sashe: Bincike") | [gyara masomin](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Buta&action=edit&section=4 "Edit section's source code: Bincike")]

buta na lantarki suka zama wata matsayin sauƙi don butas na stovetop a ƙarshe na karshen shekara ta 19. A 1893, kamfanin Crompton da Co. a Birnin Birtaniya ya fara amfani da butas na lantarki a cikin [Samfuri:Trade literature](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Samfuri:Trade_literature?action=edit&redlink=1 "Samfuri:Trade literature (babu wannan shafin)") dinsa. Amma, butas na lantarki na farko sun gano sun fiye da shekara ne saboda na'urar daukar wuta ba zai iya kara da ruwa ba. A yanzu, an samu 'compartment' na kusa daga sama daga sakamako na ruwan da ake amfani dashi don daukar na'urar daukar wutan lantarki. Bayanin butas na lantarki na farko sun fi daga farko don daukar wutar lantarki na stovetop na lokacin. A 1902, 'Archer' butas na lantarki da aka rubuta da Premier Electric Heaters a Birmingham, Ingilishi, ya tattauna kama. Yana da na'urar daukar wuta mai zafi a sama na buta (ba a haifar da ruwan ba), kuma shine wani daga buta na farko da aka samu da na wutar zama mai amfani. A 1922, Leslie Large, wani injinia mai daɗin riko daga Bulpitt & Sons daga Birmingham, ya hana na'urar kwakwalwa mai da wayar da aka watsa da kuma na na'ura a ciki na tala. Na'urar zai iya daukar wutar kuma tana da matsala fiye da buta na stovetop na lokacin. A 1955, kamfanin Ingilishi mai tattalin arziki na [Russell Hobbs](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Russell_Hobbs?action=edit&redlink=1 "Russell Hobbs (babu wannan shafin)") ya raba matattar sai dai ya yi zama a wani jerin tattalin buta na stainless steel na farko na K1.[[3]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Buta#cite_note-3)

Whistling butas shine wani tukunyar da aka kafa shi tare da wani gajeren da ya goge sautin [whistle](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Whistle?action=edit&redlink=1 "Whistle (babu wannan shafin)") lokacin da ruwan a cikin buta ya fara tafasa. Wannan aiki mai nuna goge shi ne ya kawo tsawo, kamar yadda a fashewa a fizikansa a matsayin [tone hole](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tone_hole?action=edit&redlink=1 "Tone hole (babu wannan shafin)").[[4]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Buta#cite_note-Henrywood2013-4)

Tun da haka, sabuwar fahimta da aka kasancewa an samu na jiran yadda wannan aiki ya faru a wani littafi mai suna _The Aeroacoustics of a Steam buta_, da aka rubuta ta da R. H. Henrywood, wanda yana makaranta a shekarar bakwai a farkon Ingilishi na Cambridge, da A. Agarwal, mai tsage hannu, a jaridar _[Physics of Fluids](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Physics\_of\_Fluids?action=edit&redlink=1 "Physics of Fluids (babu wannan shafin)")_ a shekara ta 2013.[[4]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Buta#cite_note-Henrywood2013-4)[[5]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Buta#cite_note-UoC-5)

Harry Bramson ne wanda ya bada buta na tea mai goge sautin.[[6]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Buta#cite_note-6)

## buta's na Tea mai atomatik

[[gyara sashe](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Buta&veaction=edit&section=6 "Gyara sashe: buta's na Tea mai atomatik") | [gyara masomin](https://ha.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Buta&action=edit&section=6 "Edit section's source code: buta's na Tea mai atomatik")]

butas na Tea mai atomatik sun kasance wani matsayin sauƙi don tattara inganta da shayin tea, an samu su da nau'in amfani don bada kayan abinci na tea daga baya. Bayan samun zama, butas na tea mai atomatik ya dauka ruwan har zuwa wurin har zuwa siffa don haɗa sahu gaba. Wannan shi ne saboda nau'in kayan abinci mai yawa na [tea](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tea?action=edit&redlink=1 "Tea (babu wannan shafin)") za'a buɗe a cikin saukin da take da inganci mai buƙatar karar kwabo da suke a sanyin matsala. [[7]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Buta#cite_note-7) A kowanne lokaci za su yi jin kamar jiran na biyu don yin farin ciki idan ya hau ƙarshen ruwan ya tashi, kuma yana da ingantaccen zama daga baya na ruwan bayan haɗin inganci.[[8]](https://ha.wikipedia.org/wiki/Buta#cite_note-8)

intanet ta haɗa duka duniya wuri ɗaya domin mutanen su tattauna, su nemi ilimi, su yi kasuwanci, su nishaɗantu ko su ajiye bayani.

Al'ummar wasu garuruwan arewacin Zamfara da ke Najeriya, na ci gaba kokawa akan katsewar Internet a wasu yankunansu tsawon wattani uku ba tare da sanar da su dalilan da ya sa hukumomi suka ɗauki matakin hakan ba. Al'ummar kananan hukumomin Kauran Namoda da Shinkafi da Zurmi da kuma Birnin Magaji, sun ce rashin intanet din ya jefa su cikin tsaka mai wuya. Mazauna wadannan yankuna sun ce rashin intanet din ya sanya ala tilas suna tsallakawa zuwa yankunan makwabtansu kafin su samu intanet don biyan bukatunsu. Kwamared Abdulrazak Bello Kaura, shi ne sakataren watsa labarai na kungiyar kula da ci gaban Kauran Namoda, ya shaida wa BBC cewa, da farko matsalar ta fara da rashin iya kiran waya sai mun je har Gusau, sannan zamu iya kiran waya. Ya ce,"To daga baya sai aka dawo ana iya kiran waya, daga nan kuma sai intanet y afara daukewa, ya zamana bama iya siyan data ballanata mu yi abu da ya shafi amfani da intanet da wayoyinmu na salula ko kuma kwamfuta. "Ba ma iya komai sai dai mu je shagunan da ke amfani da intanet wanda suke siya don yi sana'a wanda anan idan kaje kudin da zaka biya don tura wani sako ko amfani da intanet din ta sun a wani kankanin lokaci na da yawan gaske." In ji shi. Kwamared Abdulrazak Bello Kaura, ya ce "Wannan matsala ta rashin intanet din ta tilastawa matasa da dama barin gari domin su je ci gaba da harkokinsu na kasuwanci da suke amfani da intanet,"
